targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  -- 📍 Hidden fields specifically for Meshview Data Links
  MAX(REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '')) AS "raw_sender_id",
  MAX(REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '')) AS "raw_target_id",

  COALESCE(MAX(sn.long_name), MAX(REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', ''))) AS "Sender",
  CASE
    WHEN MAX(REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '')) IN ('ffffffff', '4294967295', '^all') THEN 'Broadcast'
    ELSE COALESCE(MAX(dn.long_name), MAX(REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '')))
  END AS "Target",
  MAX(m.portnum) AS "App / Port",
  MAX(m.hop_start) AS "Max Hops",
  MAX(m.message_size_bytes) AS "Size (Bytes)",
  MAX(m.transport_mechanism) AS "Transport",
  BOOL_OR(m.want_ack) AS "Ack Requested",
  BOOL_OR(m.pki_encrypted) AS "PKI Encrypted",
  MIN(m.time) AS "First Heard"
FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
LEFT JOIN node_details sn ON REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(sn.node_id::text, '!', '')
LEFT JOIN node_details dn ON REPLACE(m.destination_id::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(dn.node_id::text, '!', '')
WHERE m.packet_id = NULLIF('${packet_id}', '')::bigint;

SELECT
  -- 📍 Calculates seconds elapsed since the very first gateway reported this packet
  '+' || ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (m.time - MIN(m.time) OVER()))::numeric, 2) || 's' AS "Time Offset",
  
  (m.hop_start - m.hop_limit) AS "Hops Taken",
  m.rx_snr AS "SNR",
  m.rx_rssi AS "RSSI",
  COALESCE(gn.long_name, REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '')) AS "Reporting Gateway",
  
  -- 📍 Combines the decimal byte with the padded 0x Hex equivalent
  m.relay_node AS "raw_relay_byte", -- Hidden field for the data link
  m.relay_node::text || ' (0x' || lower(lpad(to_hex(m.relay_node::integer), 2, '0')) || ')' AS "Relay Byte",
  
  -- 📍 The Upgraded Uplink Derivation
  (
    SELECT STRING_AGG(
      DISTINCT COALESCE(sn.long_name, REPLACE(sn.node_id::text, '!', '')) || 
      ' (!' || lower(to_hex(REPLACE(sn.node_id::text, '!', '')::bigint)) || ')', 
      E'\n'
    )
    FROM node_details sn
    -- The modulo check, plus the FF/00 exception
    WHERE (
        MOD(REPLACE(sn.node_id::text, '!', '')::numeric, 256) = m.relay_node::numeric
        OR (m.relay_node::numeric = 255 AND MOD(REPLACE(sn.node_id::text, '!', '')::numeric, 256) = 0)
      )
      AND REPLACE(sn.node_id::text, '!', '') NOT IN (REPLACE(m.source_id::text, '!', ''), REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', ''))
      
      -- 📍 The STRICT Adjacency Filter
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 
          FROM mesh_packet_metrics history
          WHERE REPLACE(history.source_id::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(sn.node_id::text, '!', '')
            AND REPLACE(history.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '')
            
            -- 📍 THE FIX: Only count it if the gateway hears them DIRECTLY (0 hops)
            AND history.hop_start = history.hop_limit 
            
            AND history.time > NOW() - INTERVAL '3 days'
      )
  ) AS "Likely Relay Nodes"

FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
LEFT JOIN node_details gn ON REPLACE(m.reporting_gateway::text, '!', '') = REPLACE(gn.node_id::text, '!', '')
WHERE m.packet_id = NULLIF('${packet_id}', '')::bigint
ORDER BY "Hops Taken" ASC, "Time Offset" ASC;
